zh.lead: 從需求梳理、資訊架構到上線交付，由我方負責全權的規劃、設計與開發。
zh.coreDesc: 適用於從 0 到 1 全新建立的品牌／企業網站，由我方負責網站規劃、設計、開發與上線。
zh.coreScopeLabel: 基礎範圍｜最多 5 種核心頁面版型
zh.st0Desc: 了解品牌、商業目標、目標受眾與網站需求，初步確認專案範圍、預計頁面與合作方式。
zh.st0Note: ※ 此階段不收費，會議後若未接續合作亦無需支付費用。
zh.payDepositDesc: 雙方確認報價與合作內容後簽署／確認合作，並支付 50% 訂金。款項入帳後保留檔期並正式啟動。
zh.st1Desc: 正式啟動後深入確認專案範圍、頁面規劃與合作方式；同步提供網站所需的文案、圖片、Logo、品牌素材清單與提交規格。
zh.st2Desc: 提出網站架構、頁面配置與內容方向，與你確認各頁需要呈現的資訊、溝通重點與內容缺口；依確認後的架構完成所需素材盤點。
zh.st3Desc: 依提供的圖片與品牌素材進行內容配置，並提出網站整體視覺方向，確認色彩、字體、圖片風格與品牌呈現方式。
zh.st4Desc: 提供主要頁面設計進行 Review，確認版面、內容層級、圖文配置與使用體驗，並依回饋完成設計調整。
zh.st5Desc: 網站完成初步開發後提供可實際操作的預覽版本，與你確認桌機／手機呈現、互動效果與實際內容。
zh.st6Desc: 正式上線前進行完整網站確認，包含文案、圖片、連結、表單、頁面呈現與主要使用流程。
zh.payFinalDesc: Final Review 完成後，於網站正式上線前支付剩餘 50% 尾款。
zh.st7Desc: 完成正式網址串接與網站上線，並交付網站相關資產與基本操作說明。
zh.vsSecSub: 依你的需求，進一步探索可延伸的各項服務。
zh.maintDesc: 僅適用於由我方建置的網站，以既有架構內的內容更新為範圍。
zh.maint1Inc: 文字、圖片、連結、聯絡資訊、既有表格資料、小幅排版調整等
zh.maint2Name: 網站基礎維護｜6 個月方案
zh.maint2Inc: 每月 2 小時內容維護、基本網站狀況確認、需求優先排程
zh.maintNote: 6 個月方案每月包含 2 小時，未使用工時不累計至次月；需求以彙整後批次提出為原則。
zh.pagesDesc: 所有擴充頁面原則上皆延續既有品牌設計系統與元件，主要依頁面版面、資訊架構與互動複雜度區分價格。
zh.pg1Desc: 頁面結構單純，大多可沿用既有版型與元件。
zh.pg1Items: 圖文置入、既有區塊重新組合、版面調整、RWD、SEO 基礎設定、開發與 QA
zh.pg2Desc: 維持既有品牌元件，但整頁版面、資訊層級與區塊組合需要重新規劃。
zh.pg2Items: 頁面 UX 架構、客製版面、元件組合、RWD、開發與 QA
zh.pg3Desc: 整頁具有較強的內容敘事、特殊視覺節奏或互動需求。
zh.pg3Items: 完整頁面流程、特殊版面、進階動態與互動、RWD、開發與 QA
zh.ad1Desc: 英文轉譯、英文頁面建置、語系切換、版面適配與基本 QA；品牌／產品／專有名詞由客戶提供正式英文
zh.ad2Desc: 篩選功能、複雜表單流程、資料查詢或其他超出一般企業網站之功能
zh.ad3Desc: KV、複雜影像合成、特殊插畫等
zh.sum1Name: 品牌／企業網站｜最多 5 種頁面版型
zh.sum6Name: 單次內容維護／超出工時
zh.sum7Name: 網站基礎維護｜6 個月方案
zh.sumNote: 以上價格為未稅報價基準，實際費用依專案範圍與內容量另行確認。

en.lead: From strategy and structure to launch — I handle the full planning, design, and development.
en.coreDesc: For brands and businesses building a website from scratch — I handle the planning, design, development, and launch.
en.st0Desc: We get to know your brand, business goals, audience, and website needs — and outline the project scope, pages, and how we'll work together.
en.st0Note: ※ This stage is free. If we don't move forward after the call, there's no charge.
en.payDepositDesc: Once we've confirmed the quote and scope, we sign off and you pay a 50% deposit. Your slot is reserved and the project officially begins.
en.st1Desc: We confirm the project scope, page plan, and workflow in detail — and you provide the copy, images, logo, and brand assets, with a checklist and specs.
en.st2Desc: I propose the site structure, page layout, and content direction — confirming what each page needs to show, its key message, and any content gaps — then complete an asset inventory.
en.st3Desc: I lay out the content with your images and brand assets, and propose the overall visual direction — colors, typography, imagery, and how the brand is expressed.
en.st4Desc: I share the main page designs for review, confirming layout, content hierarchy, and user experience — then refine based on your feedback.
en.st5Desc: Once initial development is done, I share a working preview so you can check the desktop and mobile experience, interactions, and real content.
en.st6Desc: A full pre-launch review — copy, images, links, forms, page rendering, and the main user flows.
en.payFinalDesc: After the final review, the remaining 50% is paid before the site goes live.
en.st7Desc: I connect the domain, take the site live, and hand over the site assets and a basic guide to managing it.
en.vsSecSub: Explore the services you can extend, based on your needs.
en.maintDesc: Available only for sites I've built, covering content updates within the existing structure.
en.maint1Inc: Text, images, links, contact info, existing table data, minor layout tweaks, etc.
en.maint2Inc: 2 hours of content updates per month, basic site health check, priority scheduling
en.maintNote: The 6-month plan includes 2 hours per month; unused hours don't roll over. Requests are handled in batches.
en.pagesDesc: All extra pages follow your existing brand design system and components; pricing depends mainly on layout, information architecture, and interaction complexity.
en.pg1Desc: Simple page structure, mostly reusing existing templates and components.
en.pg1Items: Content placement, reworking existing blocks, layout adjustments, RWD, basic SEO, development & QA
en.pg2Desc: Keeps your existing brand components, but the full layout, hierarchy, and block composition are planned from scratch.
en.pg2Items: Page UX architecture, custom layout, component composition, RWD, development & QA
en.pg3Desc: A page with strong content narrative, distinct visual rhythm, or interaction needs.
en.pg3Items: Full page flow, custom layout, advanced motion & interaction, RWD, development & QA
en.ad1Desc: English translation, English page build, language switching, layout adaptation, and basic QA; brand/product/proper nouns provided by the client in their official English.
en.ad2Desc: Filtering, complex form flows, data lookup, or other features beyond a standard business site
en.ad3Desc: Key visuals, complex image compositing, custom illustration, etc.
en.sum1Name: Brand / Business website｜Up to 5 page templates
en.sumNote: Prices are before tax; final cost is confirmed based on project scope and content volume.
